Record Class PacketDebugFormatter.HexPreview

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.meshtastic.client.utils.PacketDebugFormatter.HexPreview
Record Components:
addressText - address column
hexText - HEX column
asciiText - ASCII column
hexByteStartChars - start character index for each byte in the HEX view
hexByteEndChars - end character index for each byte in the HEX view
asciiByteStartChars - start character index for each byte in the ASCII view
asciiByteEndChars - end character index for each byte in the ASCII view
Enclosing class:
PacketDebugFormatter
public static record PacketDebugFormatter.HexPreview(String addressText, String hexText, String asciiText, int[] hexByteStartChars, int[] hexByteEndChars, int[] asciiByteStartChars, int[] asciiByteEndChars) extends Record
Prepared HEX/ASCII packet preview with byte-to-character mappings. Used to highlight HEX and ASCII columns independently when tree nodes are selected.
